Object-level accuracy of field delineation

Source: R/metrics.R
fb_evaluate.Rd

Compares predicted field objects with reference fields using the object metric of the Fields of The World benchmark. Reference objects are the 4-connected components of field pixels; predicted objects are the 4-connected components of each label. A reference and a predicted object match when their intersection over union exceeds iou (with iou >= 0.5 every match is one-to-one). Unmatched predicted objects with more than half of their pixels unlabelled (class 3) are not counted as false positives (obj_fp); obj_fp_all counts all of them.

Usage

fb_evaluate(
  reference,
  fields,
  iou = 0.5,
  pixel_area = NA_real_,
  size_breaks_ha = c(0, 1, 5, 20, 50, Inf),
  field = 1L,
  unlabelled = 3L
)

Arguments

reference

Reference classes: a raster from fb_reference() (its class layer is used) or an integer matrix (0 background, 1 field, 2 boundary, 3 unlabelled).

fields

Predicted objects: a raster from fb_delineate() or an integer matrix.

iou

Matching threshold (at least 0.5).

pixel_area

Pixel area in square metres for the size classes; computed from the raster when reference is a SpatRaster.

size_breaks_ha

Breaks of the reference-field size classes in hectares.

field, unlabelled

Class codes.

Value

A one-row data frame of counts: pixel tp, fp, fn; objects obj_tp, obj_fp, obj_fp_all, obj_fn, n_pred; and reference fields and matches per size class (ref_s<k>, hit_s<k>). Summarise with fb_accuracy().

Examples

s <- fb_example_stack("california")
f <- fb_example_files("california")
ref <- fb_reference(sf::st_read(f$fields, quiet = TRUE), s)
m <- fb_model_pretrained("california")
fields <- fb_delineate(fb_tbc_maps(s, m), thresholds = m$thresholds)
ev <- fb_evaluate(ref, fields)
ev
#>      tp   fp   fn obj_tp obj_fn obj_fp obj_fp_all n_pred ref_s1 hit_s1 ref_s2
#> 1 26370 2357 1000     10      1      2          2     12      1      0      4
#>   hit_s2 ref_s3 hit_s3 ref_s4 hit_s4 ref_s5 hit_s5
#> 1      4      6      6      0      0      0      0
fb_accuracy(ev)
#>   tiles pixel_precision pixel_recall pixel_iou reference_fields
#> 1     1       0.9179518    0.9634636 0.8870724               11
#>   predicted_fields obj_precision obj_recall    obj_f1 ref_s1 recall_s1 ref_s2
#> 1               12     0.8333333  0.9090909 0.8695652      1         0      4
#>   recall_s2 ref_s3 recall_s3 ref_s4 recall_s4 ref_s5 recall_s5
#> 1         1      6         1      0        NA      0        NA
